harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#563; borg-reborn-rs #810, PR #813). Paired classes-18
pilot, the same two starts per class in all three arms, 100,000 turns, one binary, 54 games. The floor applies to gold
remaining after the purchase: at 125 gold per scroll a character with none needs 525, 650 or 775 gold for the three targets.
Gate: one binary; each arm's settings in params-core.json; usable receipts (town-plan.jsonl, town-transactions.jsonl,
messages.log, state.log, terminal receipts) for every cell; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn
bursts classified. Report how many town visits actually exercised the refill policy; if exposure is sparse or departure
inventory is missing, say so and scope the next observation pass.
Primary: for the first completed town visit after a Recall scroll was used, the fraction of departures that meet the arm's
physical scroll target, numerator and denominator per arm and per class; visits that could have filled the deficit with
observed stock and spendable gold broken out; starts that never had such a visit counted; later eligible visits secondary.
Per refill opportunity: carried count on arrival, quote and quantity at each decision, purse and spendable gold, confirmed
purchases and spend, carried count at the exit, Recall-triggered and stair departures, the last inventory-changing action;
missing inventory or unobserved stock is unknown; cached stock apart from a directly observed offer; physical scrolls apart
from spells, rods and activations. Shortfalls explained when the evidence supports it (stock, affordability with the floor,
room or weight, another purchase first, departure before shopping ended). Compare gold spent, early purchases and departure
stock of Cure Light Wounds, Phase Door and usable light or fuel; paired deaths, CL and maximum DL, including deaths before
the first refill opportunity. Keep the torch and lantern policy experiment separate. Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: After the Borg spends a Word of Recall, how often does its next town visit refill a carried reserve of one, two or three scrolls (town_recall_reserve 1, 2, 3), and does a larger reserve crowd out early healing, Phase Door or usable light?
